Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to learn more about the search-and-summarization use case and the constraints around latency and PII handling. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can get the evaluation (trial) kicked off next week: 

- Goal: run a 2-week evaluation to validate throughput, latency, and hallucination rates on your internal dataset plus a small prompt/eval set from your product team.
- Success criteria (proposed): average 95th percentile generation latency < 300ms for 512-token workflows; recall/summary precision >= 85% on the 50 prompt evals; no PII exfiltration on synthetic test vectors.
- What we'll do: schedule an evaluation kickoff (1hr) to align on the trial plan, access/credentials, dataset samples, and the prompt set for evaluations. Following the kickoff, our team will provision a dedicated evaluation instance and share a short checklist for data onboarding.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 2026-12-08 at 10:00am or 2:00pm
- Wed 2026-12-09 at 11:00am

Neha (cc) will join the kickoff for technical onboarding and to go over the evaluation plan workbook (attached). I attached a starter evaluation plan and a draft SOW for your procurement/legal teams to review.

Next steps: pick one of the times above that works for you and confirm attendees. If you'd like a deeper technical dive first (model internals / data handling), we can extend the kickoff or book a separate 30–45m tech session with Connor.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
